notes: «قال شعبة قال عاصم يومئذ وهذا الأعمش يرويه» is Asim's remark quoted by Shu'ba: al-A'mash is a different transmitter of the same saying, so it is a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
The main route: Shu'ba is the asker («فسألت عنه منصورا»), the first link; the report writes no earlier link
